failed_or_open_qualification_evidence.head: dc955c97155be4d8d6afb6ce226f7b9ad0435b14
failed_or_open_qualification_evidence.scope: same frozen Gate B N129 representation across Staringreeks unimodal MvG using KSATFIT and KSATEXM disabled

shared_oracle_dependency: Gate B and C1 use an independent qualification-only steady-Darcian oracle reconstructed from Ross 2011 equations and frozen SWAP 4.3.1 constitutive sources without borrowing F-LMFP implementation internals.
current_findings: Gate B qualifies the B01 N129 log-head/log-mobility face representation on a frozen unseen holdout while preserving O(1) lookup, structural sign correctness and structural hydrostatic zero-flow
C1 tested the exact same representation without retuning across all 36 Staringreeks unimodal MvG materials with KSATEXM disabled

31 of 36 C1 materials passed every frozen criterion; B13 and O15 failed only through a qualification endpoint guard, while O01, O05 and O14 exceeded the absolute flux-error threshold and are genuine representation generalisation failures
C1 is therefore fail-closed and may not be rewritten as a pass after endpoint repair

C1 failure does not yet establish a RossFast no-go because a revised bounded shared representation may be characterized in a separate fresh refinement gate under the same 262144-byte class-memory ceiling
catalog-wide SWAP hydraulic generalisation remains the primary hard blocker; no groundwater or MultiSWAP promotion follows from Gate B
next_action: Run a separate C1R bounded-representation refinement using fresh characterization probes, then freeze a new unseen holdout if a candidate passes characterization. Preserve the failed C1 evidence. In parallel keep KSATEXM and other SWAP hydraulic families outside C1R until the base unimodal catalog representation is resolved.
